entry.prompt: Graceful elven tree: one straight smooth pale trunk forking once high up under a tall rounded canopy of four fused chunky lobes, crown taller than wide, one flat round lobe jutting at mid height, no roots showing. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism that reads from above. Solid closed volumes, no individual leaves, no thin branches, hard edges, flat faces. entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Canopy: warm autumn gold (#C9A548) with pale gold sunlit lobe tops (#E3C872) and soft olive-gold undersides (#8C7F3E). Trunk: smooth silver-white bark (#DAD6C8) with faint grey-teal streaks (#9FB0AA). A little moss at the foot (#6E9A55). Luminous and clean but not neon, matching pale ivory elven stone. No flowers, no fruit, no text or logos.
